description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and Eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio in percentage, ranging from 100% to 25% with a linear scale and tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Four lines are shown: a red dashed line, a grey line with square markers, a dark blue line with circular markers, and a blue line with cross markers. The red dashed line remains steady at approximately 11.5 across the x-axis. The grey line starts at around 11.5 at 100% and ends at approximately 11.8 at 25%, with a slight dip to around 11.4 at 75% before rising to about 11.6 at 50%. The dark blue line begins at roughly 11.5 at 100% and increases to about 14.3 at 25%, with values around 11.6 at 75% and 12.0 at 50%. The blue line starts at approximately 11.5 at 100%, increases to around 11.7 at 75%, then to about 12.1 at 50%, and finally reaches around 13.2 at 25%.
